# Without GOEXPERIMENT=simd the slice sums lower to the scalar loop:
# sums match the oracle and the binary references no vector
# support and no masked vector tail.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^sums ok$'
logos build -o $WORK/exe .
go tool objdump $WORK/exe
! stdout 'archsimd'
! stdout 'VPMASKMOVD'
! stdout 'VPMASKMOVQ'
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/simddefault

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

//go:noinline
func sumI32(xs []int32) int32 { return xs.sum() }

//go:noinline
func sumF64(xs []float64) float64 { return xs.sum() }

func main() {
	if sumI32([]int32{1, 2, 3}) != 6 {
		panic("i32")
	}
	if sumF64([]float64{1.5, 2.5}) != 4.0 {
		panic("f64")
	}
	fmt.Println("sums ok")
}
